_comment: Bundle size baseline consumed by scripts/check_bundle_size.py (bundle-size-gate.yml). Each entry pins the on-disk size of one public distribution unit as built on the ubuntu-24.04 CI runner. A missing artifact or a null size fails the gate. After an intended size change, copy observed_bytes from the CI job's bundle-size-report.json (or run 'uv run python scripts/check_bundle_size.py --update-baseline' on a full build) and commit it in the same PR. tolerance is fractional (0.03 = 3%) and applies in both directions. schema_version pins the JSON shape so future migrations can warn rather than silently misread.
